study: Jacob, Hill & Corey 2017 — Math Solutions 3-year math PD RCT
eval_evidence: Impact evaluation authored by university researchers Jacob, Hill & Corey, who are independent of Math Solutions (the commercial PD vendor whose program was tested). The study team observed the PD sessions but did not develop or own the program.
developer_evidence: The PD was delivered by Math Solutions' own staff/associates ('Math Solutions staff worked with the teachers'; 'Math Solutions hand-selects and extensively trains full-time associates'), i.e., the program's developers delivered directly rather than via trained intermediaries or the school system.
cascade_evidence: Math Solutions staff/associates delivered the summer institutes and in-service days directly to the study teachers; no train-the-trainer/lead-teacher layer.
counterfactual_evidence: Control teachers were 'business as usual'; as an incentive the district offered them an UNRELATED science PD (and a science instructional coach), not an alternative math PD — so the math counterfactual is true BAU.
coaching_evidence: Program = week-long summer institute each year + 4-6 in-service days/year (>40 contact hrs/yr), workshop/course format. Report states 'Distance learning and coaching were proposed by the Math Solutions team but not taken up by the teachers' — no ongoing in-class coaching was actually delivered.
student_dose_evidence: Teacher-facing PD only; changes the teacher's regular math instruction. No tutoring, pull-out, extra instructional minutes, or student-facing software dose.
maturity_evidence: Three-year PD program; the extracted student-achievement effect sizes are the T4 wave (spring of Year 3, end of the 3-year treatment), by which point teachers had ≥1 prior implementation year (experienced).
